name: Viking longhouse
desc: one long smoky room where a household eats, argues and sleeps through the winter
tags: viking longhouse interior, long open hearth down the centre, smoke drifting up to the roof vent, carved timber posts, turf roof underside, low benches along both walls, hanging round shields, iron cauldron on a chain, wool blankets, drinking horns
prose: the interior of a viking longhouse, a long open hearth burning down the centre with smoke drifting up to the roof vent, carved timber posts and a turf roof overhead, benches along both walls hung with round shields and an iron cauldron chained above the fire
note: Defaults to a generic fantasy tavern with a stone fireplace in the wall. Three corrections do it: the hearth is OPEN and runs down the CENTRE of the floor, the smoke goes up to a hole in the roof, and the roof overhead is turf and timber. Shields on the wall are the fastest cue but alone they give a theme-pub look - keep the cauldron and benches with them.
